title: Shell completion for subspacectl
body:
Typing task ids is slow.

- `subspacectl completion bash|zsh|fish` prints a completion script.
- Completion of task and agent ids queries the server (owner token from the usual config) with a 300 ms timeout and falls back to no suggestions.
- Golden-file tests for the three generated scripts.

repos.name: SigmaUno/subspace
repos.description: Go server and cmd/subspacectl, a flag-based CLI without third-party dependencies

requirements.title: Generate bash, zsh and fish completion scripts
Complete task and agent ids from the server with a timeout
